title: How Credit Cards Make Money Even If You Pay in Full
description:
How do credit card companies make money if you pay your bill in full every month? Every tap of your card triggers a hidden swipe fee, and that fee, plus interest and fees from people who carry a balance, is how the whole system makes money.

In this video: the five players behind every card payment, what happens in the 2 seconds after you tap, who gets the swipe fee, where rewards really come from, and why even cash payers help pay for them.
